test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 28 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Six people, A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting in a straight line, facing north.

Only three people sit to the left of E. B sits second to the right of E. Only three people sit between A and C. C sits immediately left of D.

How many people sit between D and F?
solution:
**Given: **Six people, A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting in a straight line, facing north.

Only three people sit to the left of E. B sits second to the right of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9772edba900f1201c4c183cc37d02a6fcfc51b5c4829644c8db305e66ca2e6de.png] 

C sits immediately left of D. Only three people sit between A and C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5de4a89ce581f593ec14b4c36209e2b4752486665732973a35b34e29235897ba.png] 

Final arrangement, 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ddbd697be5f946739bf90213e74402714cb7763de8a93f3dfd2433a96743c6a.png] 

Thus, None is between the D and F.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 3".**
